title: Compatible henselian G-ring stage for a finite etale closed-fibre cover
statement: Let (A,I) be a henselian pair [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} A proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and V finite etale over Y_0=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec} A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I) [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category, def-pc-fibre-product]. There exist a commutative G-ring B [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], an ideal J with (B,J) henselian, a proper g:Z\to\operatorname{Spec} B, a morphism s:Y\to Z, a morphism k:Y_0\to Z_0=Z\times_{\operatorname{Spec} B}\operatorname{Spec}(B/J), and a finite etale W\to Z_0 such that s\circ j_Y=j_Z\circ k, where j_Y and j_Z are the first projections of these closed-fibre pullbacks, and W\times_{Z_0}Y_0\cong V as Y_0-schemes. This statement asserts no finite etale lift of V to Y or of W to Z.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-finite-type-closed-fibre-stage] to obtain R, alpha, the proper h:X -> Spec R, p, q and the finite etale U on X_0. Its two projection compatibilities and U pulled back along q isomorphic to V are retained. This is exactly steps 1-4 of the original plan, without using henselianness yet.

proof.text: Put K=alpha^{-1}(I). Apply pair_henselization to obtain its cocone c, B=c.pt.right, eta:R -> B, and J=K.map eta. The cocone supplies henselianness of (B,J) and bijectivity of R/K -> B/J. R is a G-ring by isGRing_of_finiteType_int; isGRing_of_pair_henselization proves B is a G-ring.

proof.text: Since K.map alpha <= I, henselization_universal_property gives beta:B -> A with beta.comp eta=alpha and J.map beta <= I. Put Z=pullback h (Spec eta), with proper g=pullback.snd h (Spec eta). Define s by pullback.lift p (f followed by Spec beta). Its commutativity is p followed by h=f followed by Spec alpha and Spec beta followed by Spec eta=Spec alpha.

proof.text: The proved private helper closedFibre_baseChange_iso pastes the two pullbacks and base-changes the quotient isomorphism, using pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso and pullback.map_isIso. It gives e:Z_0 isomorphic to X_0 with both projection identities. Put k=q followed by e.inv. The quotient map n:Spec(A/I) -> Spec(B/J) satisfies n followed by Spec(eta mod ideals)=Spec(alpha mod ideals) and n followed by Spec(B -> B/J)=Spec(A -> A/I) followed by Spec beta. Cancelling the quotient isomorphism proves k.snd=Y_0.snd followed by n. Pullback.hom_ext, the first projection compatibility of q, and this second projection equality then prove j_Y followed by s=k followed by j_Z.

proof.text: Define W by pulling U back along e.hom; finite and etale are stable under base change. Since k followed by e.hom=q, pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso and pullback.congrHom give W pulled back along k isomorphic to U pulled back along q, over Y_0. Compose with the given isomorphism to V. The code constructs the Over isomorphism and verifies its projection, so no lifting theorem is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_henselian_gRing_stage
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [HenselianRing A I]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f]
    (V : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤
      (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsGRing B)
      (J : Ideal B) (_ : HenselianRing B J) (Z : Scheme.{u})
      (g : Z ⟶ Spec (.of B)) (_ : IsProper g) (s : Y ⟶ Z)
      (k : pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ⟶
        pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J))))
      (W : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤
        (pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J))))),
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ≫ s =
        k ≫ pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)))) ∧
      Nonempty (Over.mk (pullback.snd W.hom k) ≅ Over.mk V.hom)
